# Brian Yue

> Mechanical engineering junior at Duke University, working toward a certificate in aerospace engineering. B.S.E. in Mechanical Engineering, graduating May 2028. Based in Durham, NC. I design aerospace hardware, draw it up properly with GD&T, check it with FEA, and then help machine it.

This is my portfolio. Every page is plain HTML and readable without JavaScript. The project pages say what was mine, what was a teammate's, and what I would do differently.

## Experience
- [Floating-element shear-force balance](https://brianyue.me/work/shear-balance): Internship, NC State, Finished, Jun 2026 to Aug 2026. I designed it, ran the FEA and drew up the five-sheet drawing package. When friction data came in from a grad student's similar rig, I switched to a $159 ball-bearing carriage.
- [Transonic truss-braced wing review](https://brianyue.me/work/ttbw): Research, Duke, Published, AIAA AVIATION, Jun 2026. I wrote this AIAA paper on my own from 53 sources, then presented it at AVIATION 2026 with two of the authors I'd cited in the room.

## Projects
- [Unified forward closure](https://brianyue.me/work/forward-closure): Project, Flown, Duke Aero, Aug 2025 to present. We used to machine three forward closures for every motor. I redesigned them as one part, and that part flew.
- [Modular Happy Meal train](https://brianyue.me/work/happy-meal): Project, Toy Fair 2025, Duke, Spring 2025. I modeled most of this Happy Meal train in Onshape. Kids swap the heads to build their own, and it costs $0.31 to make.
- [Accessible PlaySeat](https://brianyue.me/work/playseat): Project, Delivered, Duke EGR 101, Sep 2024 to Dec 2024. We built a play seat for a three-year-old who loves Formula 1. The first time he sat in it, we learned the wheels were in the wrong place.

## Leadership
- [ISSDC captain, then advisor](https://brianyue.me/leadership/issdc): Leadership, Global Champion, Sep 2021 to Aug 2024. I designed space settlements against the clock for three years, and my company won the 2023 Global Finals at Kennedy Space Center.
- [Teaching assistant, Duke](https://brianyue.me/leadership/teaching): Leadership, Ongoing, Aug 2025 to present. I TA EGR 105, the computing class I took my first semester, and grade for ME 221.
- [Student coach, Tsinghua International School](https://brianyue.me/leadership/coaching): Leadership, Finished, Sep 2020 to May 2024. I coached middle schoolers in Beijing for four years while playing varsity myself, and became head coach of two teams.

## Smaller work
- [Simulating the ISS deorbit](https://brianyue.me/work/smaller-work#iss-deorbit): EGR 105, Fall 2024, Team project. Our team simulated the ISS falling out of orbit. I wrote the orbital decay code, RK4 integrator and all.
- [Checking a snap-fit with FEA](https://brianyue.me/work/smaller-work#snap-fit-fea): ME 321, Fall 2026. I ran the FEA on a printed snap-fit grip, then printed it to check that it really snaps.
- [Space Shuttle Vanguard](https://brianyue.me/work/smaller-work#vanguard): EGR 101, Fall 2024. I went way overboard on a CAD assignment for EGR 101, lettering and all.
